presets.name: Bare
presets.description: The style stripped back: no background, so the face sits on whatever your page is, and the accessory component switched off.

presets.name: Terracotta
presets.summary: A warm red-brown set built around the fixed features.
presets.description: Not quite a sepia. Big Smile paints its eyes a fixed brown and the inside of most mouths a fixed red, neither reachable by any option. Leaning the whole palette warm and red takes both in rather than leaving them as the two loud spots on an otherwise brown face. Accessories switch off, since most of them carry their own colors.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: Dusty hair, skin left to the seed.
presets.description: The style ships four naturals and four brights for hair. This replaces all eight with dusty tones that sit closer together, so a page of these reads as one set.

presets.name: Electric
presets.summary: Hair at full saturation on near black.
presets.description: The other direction on the same lever: six hair colors past anything the style ships, on a dark background so they read as lit. Skin still comes from the seed.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.summary: Five soft backgrounds, everything else untouched.
presets.description: Changes nothing about the people, only what they stand in front of. The lightest way to make a set of avatars feel like it belongs together.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.description: The loud counterpart to Pastel Wall. Strong enough that the avatar holds its own against a busy page, and the only preset here that will fight with a colorful interface rather than sit inside it.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient behind, everything else untouched.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. The seed still decides which of the two ends up on top.

presets.name: Night Shift
presets.summary: Near black behind, light hair in front.
presets.description: For dark interfaces. The hair pool drops to the pale end so the silhouette does not disappear into the background.

presets.name: Full Cast
presets.description: The accessory component sits at fifty percent, so half the avatars come out plain. This puts one on all of them, which suits a demo better than a user list.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.summary: Scaled in on the face, for small avatars.
presets.description: Uses scale rather than color. At the size a comment thread gives an avatar, the default framing spends a lot of it on empty space, and cropping in buys the detail back.
